name: Laced Pumpkin
summary: At Apothecary Johaan's hand, Laced Pumpkin turns an ordinary gourd into a deadly test of Forsaken alchemy. In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society seeks weapons against the Scourge and living human forces.

sections.title: A Bitter Harvest
sections.body: In Tirisfal Glades, the pumpkin looks like ordinary produce salvaged from blighted soil. Apothecary Johaan in Brill treats it with experimental toxins meant to realize the full potential of undeath. The Royal Apothecary Society seeks weapons against the Scourge in the north and living human forces advancing from the south. Even a simple harvest can carry infection and chemical death.

sections.title: The Cellar Experiment
sections.body: In the cellar of the Gallows' End Tavern, Forsaken captors hold a famished Captured Scarlet Zealot. The prisoner accepts a tainted offering as sustenance, desperate for nourishment. The laced pumpkin holds Apothecary Johaan's concoction, and eating it triggers a violent transformation. The human zealot becomes a mindless ghoul, stumbling briefly in agony before collapsing dead on the cold stone floor.

faq.answer: Laced Pumpkin is an ordinary field gourd treated with an experimental formula concocted by Apothecary Johaan in Brill. The formula is meant to test the effects of Forsaken alchemy on living subjects.
A Captured Scarlet Zealot, imprisoned by Forsaken captors in the cellar beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, eats the tainted offering after being starved.

faq.q: What happens when someone eats the pumpkin?
faq.answer: The pumpkin's concoction triggers a violent transformation: the prisoner becomes a mindless ghoul, stumbles briefly in agony, then collapses dead on the cold stone floor.

faq.q: Why did the Forsaken make this?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan and the Royal Apothecary Society make new biological concoctions to combat the Scourge in the north and living humans advancing from the south. They use captured enemies as test subjects.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you know the Royal Apothecary Society will use any means to secure Tirisfal against zealous living crusaders. Turning ordinary food into a weapon shows their pragmatism.
As Alliance, you know a captured zealot faces a grotesque fate in Forsaken territory. His end is a stark reminder of what may await living humans taken alive.
